EnableTheme.Name: Enable Heritage & Grimoire Theme
EnableTheme.Hint: Enables the Heritage & Grimoire visual styling for your account. Unchecking this keeps the default system styling for you without affecting other players.

Preset.Name: Visual Preset (Theme)
Preset.Hint: Choose the visual ambiance for your character sheets and windows.

StyleCoreUI.Name: Style Foundry VTT Global UI
StyleCoreUI.Hint: Applies the theme to the sidebar, chat log, hotbar, and scene controls.

Ornaments.Name: Ornaments and Borders
Ornaments.Hint: Adds thematic medallions, the level banner, and the geometric frame to sheets.

CompactMode.Name: Compact Sheet Layout
CompactMode.Hint: Slightly reduces internal padding to display more paths and inventory items without scrolling.
